title: Grand Canyon Tour with Hoover Dam and Joshua Tree
blurb: Live a unique experience visiting the west side of the Grand Canyon, land of the Hualapai natives. This tour will provide us with landscapes and enclaves such as the imposing Hoover Dam, an engineering masterpiece, Lake Mead, the largest artificial reservoir in North America, the Mojave desert and different volcanic formations in Arizona. You will have the opportunity to take the helicopter tour at Grand Canyon West if you upgrade your tour. This helicopter tour will take you 3,500 feet to the bottom of the Canyon. You will disembark from the helicopter and spend 20 to 30 minutes exploring the landing cliff.The activity is done with a guide who speaks Spanish.
